query_analysis.original_query: I have an issue with a membrane separation system for desalination. The fouling rate of our membranes has drastically increased. What operational factors should we check?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the operational parameters contributing to the increased fouling rate in our desalination membrane separation system, and recommend which operational factors should be checked to mitigate the fouling issue.

selected_agents.role: Lead investigation into membrane fouling issue
Provide expertise on membrane fouling mechanisms
Assess operational parameters affecting membrane performance

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collaborative analysis of operational and process factors influencing membrane fouling

clarification_questions: Have there been any recent changes in feed water quality or characteristics?
What are the current operating conditions and have they changed recently?
Are the pretreatment and cleaning procedures being performed as per schedule?
